correctness.rationale: Three eigenspace projectors yield exact incidence pseudoinverse data, and a rank-two inverse identity yields all damages. The comparisons reduce to a positive-coefficient polynomial, a factor proportional to p-q, and an explicitly bracketed cubic H_q; full connectedness and denominator positivity hold on p>=q>=3. Symbolic identities and 100 independently inverted rational examples plus 52 exact boundary cases were replayed. The finite checks are not used to infer the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The exact reversal at p=q(q-1)^2 distinguishes correlated hub-endpoint failures from disjoint failures in heterogeneous bipartite networks; it disproves the plausible unconditional ordering by geometric overlap, identifies all worst/best failure motifs with counts, and proves all pair interactions strictly positive. It resolves a natural fixed-budget two-link interdiction ranking over an infinite family, not merely an arbitrary numerical instance.
